Name: Yet another shed
Author: hiepbg
Description:
This mod change the shed layout. Bigger shed with 23x12 squares, for 16:9 screen.

[size=4]How to Install the Mod:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI, Advanced Location Loader, XNB loader, and Entoarox Framework.
[*]Unzip shed.xnb from the ZIP file.
[*]Put this file into your "...\Stardew Valley\Mods\XnbLoader\ModContent\Maps" folder.
[*]Run the game. Put some kegs in it and enjoy.
[/list]
